findings.summary: Requirement R1 maps to milestone M1 but M1 deliverables do not fully satisfy R1's recursive discovery requirement

evidence.note: R1 requires recursive discovery of all .md files by default
evidence.quote: recursively discover Markdown files, including all files with the ".md" extension by default

evidence.note: M1 deliverable only provides skeleton ingestion that populates raw note entries
evidence.quote: Skeleton Ingestion Plugin (C11) that scans a directory and populates the build context with raw note entries (satisfies R1 partially)

evidence.note: M1 exit criteria do not verify recursive discovery behavior

findings.summary: AT1 is mapped to both M1 and M2 but the test requires full build pipeline which is not complete until M6

evidence.note: AT1 requires complete build with output directory inspection
evidence.quote: Run the CLI build with the input directory path and a valid output directory path

evidence.note: M1 only delivers skeleton ingestion and no-op emit plugin
M6 delivers full site assembly and emit plugin

findings.summary: Requirement R2 static-only constraint cannot be verified at M1 or M2 as claimed in sample check

evidence.note: R2 requires static HTML/CSS/JS output with no server runtime
evidence.quote: static build output consisting only of HTML, CSS, JavaScript

evidence.note: AT2 requires serving output with static file server and browser verification
evidence.quote: Serve the output with a simple static file server and open the site in a browser

evidence.note: M1 has no rendering or emit deliverables to produce verifiable static output

findings.summary: AT3 mapped to M1 and M2 but requires configuration exclusion support which is delivered in M6

evidence.note: AT3 requires configuration that excludes specific Markdown files
evidence.quote: a configuration that excludes one specific Markdown file

evidence.note: File/directory exclusion support is delivered in M6
R20 exclusion is SHOULD priority, delivered in M6
